diagnosis.observedFailure: Both actual CI runs fail in Hash-Inputs before toolchain/compiler steps, after three successful source commands; same generic size/reparse exception. No Rust or Clippy compilation result exists in either run.
diagnosis.independentlyEstablishedCause: Pinned full Git blob byte inventory is 286613906B, already18178450B over unchanged256MiB; growing preserved verification archives account for265890446B. The all-tracked-source size policy no longer admits this repository snapshot.
diagnosis.notRecorded: Failure records omit triggering relative path, current file Length, cumulative total and FileAttributes. Cannot reconstruct first triggering Windows-sorted path, exact Windows checkout total or categorically exclude an earlier reparse/other filesystem condition from these original logs. Git regular modes and6.14MB raw maximum are repository metadata, not a fresh Windows attribute audit.
diagnosis.checkoutCaveat: Raw Git sizes are not labeled actual Windows checkout sizes. Archived -text rules and earlier exact CRLF proofs are retained; no loose normalization or fabricated whole-checkout SHA ledger is used.

proposedDesign.fullGitMetadataDomain: Keep the complete pinned commit/tree and every tracked path, mode, blob object ID and raw Git blob size as a separate bounded metadata ledger. Hash that ledger document; never label its object IDs or metadata digest raw checkout SHA256. Preserve complete original archive INDEX/ledger proofs separately.
proposedDesign.contentHashedDomain: Declare a versioned conservative tracked-non-evidence domain: all tracked files outside literal normalized prefix 开发计划/验证记录/. Current pinned tree has550 such files/20723460 raw Git bytes. This retains Rust/crates/tests/build.rs/Cargo/lock/config/workflows/scripts/frontend/packaging/licenses/current plans/README instead of only assuming410 Rust files exhaust compiler input. Real Windows files are still read under original64/256/reparse checks before AND after compile; actual domain totals/SHA computed on that checkout.
proposedDesign.partitionProof: Require unique complete full-tree metadata set equals the disjoint union of declared content-hashed and archive-metadata domains, no missing/unclassified path, no rooted/escape/reparse aliases. Continue exact expected commit/workflow binding and full Git clean-before/after. Keep full6940 rows bounded; do not silently relax10000.
proposedDesign.buildClosure: Review and enforce that Cargo/build.rs/include_bytes/include_str/packaging verification cannot consume excluded archived files as build input. If any archive path is referenced as build/test input, add it explicitly to the content-hashed domain with existing limits or fail. All source/attribute/build configuration that defines selection must itself be included.
proposedDesign.schemaAndClaims: Emit explicit schema/version/domain labels for before/after content SHA256 and full-Git-object metadata. Result must say SHA256 of declared non-evidence checkout domain plus full historical Git-object metadata, NOT SHA256-read every Git checkout file. Record actual first failing path/length/total/reparse bool in any later bounded failure, avoiding signed URLs or environment dumps.
